common.couldNotReachServer: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
common.noAccessBody: Your role in this company does not include what this screen needs. An administrator at your company can change that.
common.noAccessTitle: You do not have access to this
common.offline: You are offline. What you do here will be sent when the connection comes back.
errorBoundary.body: Nothing you were doing has been saved. Reloading usually clears it.
errorBoundary.heading: This page stopped working
language.changeAnyTime: You can change this at any time.
language.label: Language
language.machineTranslated: This translation has not yet been checked by a native speaker. Tell us if something reads wrongly.
app.tagline: The partner portal for carriers delivering medical supplies.
auth.demo.title: Demo sign-ins
auth.demo.intro: This is a demonstration site. Sign in with any of the accounts below.
auth.heading: Sign in to the logistics portal
auth.subheading: Use the account the marketplace invited you with.
auth.noSelfSignup: Accounts are created by {{marketplace}} operations. There is no sign-up here.
auth.existing.heading: You are already signed in
auth.existing.signedInAs: You are currently signed in as {{company}}.
auth.existing.account: The account on this browser is {{email}}.
auth.existing.explain: Creating a carrier in the marketplace console does not sign anybody in as that carrier. To open a different company’s portal, sign out and sign in with that company’s own account.
auth.existing.switch: Sign out and use another account
activate.heading: Set your password
activate.subheading: This link works once. Choose a password only you know.
activate.mismatch: Those two passwords are not the same.
activate.done: Your account is active. Sign in to continue.
activate.linkProblem: This link is not valid any more. Ask your operations contact for another.
mfa.setupBody: Your role can change who else at your company has access, so this account needs a second step. Scan this with an authenticator app, then enter the six-digit code it shows.
mfa.secretLabel: Or type this key into your app
mfa.recoveryBody: Each one works once, if you lose your phone. This is the only time they are shown.
mfa.challengeBody: Open your authenticator app and type the six digits it is showing.
dashboard.heading: Today
dashboard.noCarrierApi: This company works entirely in this portal. There is no carrier API to check.
dashboard.neverSynced: No tracking has been received yet
shipments.heading: Shipments
shipments.exportTruncated: The file holds the first {{count}} rows. Narrow the filters for a complete export.
shipments.emptyBody: When {{marketplace}} assigns your company a consignment it appears here.
shipment.rejectReason: Why are you turning it down?
shipment.rejectHint: {{team}} has to find another carrier, so say what the problem is.
shipment.accepted: Accepted. It is yours to collect.
shipment.readOnly: This shipment is no longer assigned to your company. You can read its history and change nothing.
shipment.maskedContact: Hidden. Use the call button and {{marketplace}} will connect you.
shipment.mapTextAlternative: The map shows the collection point, the last known checkpoint and the delivery address. The same places are listed above it in words.
pod.heading: Proof of delivery
pod.otpHint: Ask the person receiving it for the code {{marketplace}} sent them.
pod.required: This delivery needs more proof before it can be completed.
pickups.heading: Collections
pickups.emptyBody: Book one from a shipment, and it will show here.
dispatch.heading: Dispatch
dispatch.emptyBody: Select shipments on the shipments page to build one.
exceptions.heading: Exceptions
exceptions.emptyBody: Every shipment is running as it should.
companies.heading: Companies we carry for
companies.emptyBody: Companies appear here once your company has carried something for them.
drivers.heading: Drivers and vehicles
drivers.emptyBody: Add the people who drive for you. A name is all it takes.
drivers.stoodDown: That driver has been stood down.
drivers.broughtBack: That driver is back on the rota.
drivers.couldNotSave: The driver could not be saved.
drivers.standDownBody: {{name}} is holding {{count}} consignments. Standing them down leaves those with nobody on them until somebody else is assigned.
drivers.noMatchBody: Try a different name, or clear the status filter.
drivers.takenOff: The driver has been taken off.
drivers.noActiveDrivers: Nobody on the fleet is active. Bring a driver back on the rota first.
drivers.vehicleHint: Which van goes out with them. Optional.
drivers.addDriverHint: Type the driver's name. They do not need an account here — linking one is optional, at the bottom.
drivers.clearedForHint: Checked against every consignment before this driver can be put on it.
drivers.phoneHint: So dispatch can reach them on the road.
drivers.driverNameHint: Type their name. No account is needed.
drivers.linkAccountHint: Only if this driver also signs in here. It turns on their task list, the scanner and proof of delivery.
drivers.noVehiclesBody: Add the vans and trucks you run, so a dispatcher can say which one a consignment went out on.
drivers.addVehicleHint: Registration and type are enough. The rest helps match a vehicle to what it can carry.
drivers.fittedHint: Checked when a consignment needs it.
drivers.maxWeightHint: Leave empty if it is not recorded.
tasks.heading: My tasks
tasks.shareLocation: Share my location while I work
tasks.shareLocationBody: Your dispatcher can see where you are while a shift is running, and only then. You can turn this off at any time.
tasks.emptyBody: When your dispatcher puts a job on your round it appears here.
company.heading: My company
company.setByUboss: Set by {{team}} operations. Contact them to change it.
company.suspended: Your company is suspended and cannot take on new work. Shipments already assigned can still be completed.
exceptionType.UNMAPPED_EXTERNAL_EVENT: Carrier sent something we do not recognise
error.LOGISTICS_PARTNER_REQUIRED: This account is not attached to a logistics company. Contact {{marketplace}} operations.
error.LOGISTICS_PARTNER_NOT_ACTIVE: This logistics account is not active. Contact {{marketplace}} operations.
error.LOGISTICS_MEMBER_DISABLED: Your access has been turned off. Ask an administrator at your company.
error.LOGISTICS_MFA_SETUP_REQUIRED: Set up two-step sign-in before using the portal.
error.LOGISTICS_MFA_CHALLENGE_REQUIRED: Enter the code from your authenticator to continue.
error.SHIPMENT_TRANSITION_NOT_ALLOWED: That is not a move this shipment can make from where it is.
error.SHIPMENT_POD_REQUIRED: This delivery needs proof before it can be completed.
error.SHIPMENT_NOT_ASSIGNED: This shipment is no longer assigned to your company.
error.SHIPMENT_OTP_INVALID: That delivery code is not right, or it has expired.
error.LOGISTICS_DRIVER_NOT_ELIGIBLE: That driver is not cleared for this shipment.
error.LOGISTICS_LOCATION_PING_REJECTED: That position could not be used.
error.LOGISTICS_LOCATION_NOT_AVAILABLE: Live location is not available for this shipment.
error.FEATURE_DISABLED: The logistics portal is not enabled on this installation.
theme.label: Appearance
shell.suspendedBanner: Your company is suspended. Shipments already assigned can still be completed; no new ones will be offered.
carrierDashboard.subtitle: Where your work is, and what is at risk today.
carrierDashboard.assignedShipmentsDescri: Every consignment assigned to your company. Choose a stage to ask about it on its own.
carrierDashboard.nothingAssigned: Nothing is assigned to your company yet.
carrierDashboard.remainder: {{count}} consignments are not shown in this chart.
carrierDashboard.clampNote: Slices below one per cent are drawn at a readable minimum. The figures beside them are exact.
carrierDashboard.ai.q1: Which shipments do not have drivers?
carrierDashboard.ai.q2: Which deliveries are at risk today?
carrierDashboard.ai.q4: How is on-time delivery tracking this period?
aiInsights.title: Glovia AI Insights
aiInsights.askLabel: Ask a question about this dashboard
aiInsights.askFailed: That did not work. Try again.
aiInsights.disclosure: Answers are generated. Every figure comes from your own data, never from the model.
aiInsights.deterministic: No AI provider is configured on this installation, so this summary was built directly from your figures.
aiInsights.unavailable: The AI provider could not be reached, so this summary was built directly from your figures.
aiInsights.idle: Ask a question about the figures on this page, or choose Explain this chart.
integration.title: Your integration
integration.description: What your company covers, what it is approved to carry, and whether the tracking interface is working.
integration.name: Name
integration.trackingBody: Whether your consignments are followed through an interface, or by your own people entering events here.
integration.noneBody: Your consignments are tracked by your own team entering events in this portal. There is no interface to connect and nothing here needs setting up.
integration.readOnly: Read-only. The credentials behind an interface are held and rotated by the marketplace.
integration.noCoverage: No delivery areas have been recorded for your company yet.
integration.capabilitiesTitle: What you are approved to carry
integration.noCapabilities: Nothing special has been approved yet. Ordinary consignments are unaffected.
integration.sellersBody: Businesses whose consignments you may be offered.
integration.noSellers: No businesses are arranged with you yet.
legs.heading: Delivery legs
legs.intro: One level of a delivery that has been given to your company. Accept it, put a driver on it, and record when it starts and when you hand it over.
legs.emptyBody: When a seller or {{team}} gives your company a level of a delivery, it appears here.
legs.failed: That change could not be saved.
profile.title: My Profile
profile.description: Your company's details as the marketplace and your customers see them. Some changes are checked by {{team}} before they take effect.
profile.readOnlyRole: You can view this profile. Only an owner or administrator at your company can change it.
profile.suspended.title: Your company is suspended
profile.suspended.noReason: No reason was given. Contact {{team}} operations.
profile.hero.removeLogoBody: Your company's initial will be shown in its place until you add another.
profile.field.setByTeam: Set by {{team}} operations. Contact them to change it.
profile.field.system: Assigned by the system. It cannot be changed.
profile.problem.email: Enter an email address, like name@company.com.
profile.problem.phone: Use digits, spaces and an optional + at the start.
profile.problem.url: Enter a web address starting with http:// or https://.
profile.problem.country: Use the two-letter country code, like DE or IN.
profile.problem.hours: The closing time must be after the opening time.
profile.problem.address: An address needs at least the first line and the city.
profile.problem.timeZone: Choose a time zone from the list.
profile.problem.server: The server did not accept this. Check it and try again.
profile.problem.taken: Another logistics company already uses this name.
profile.address.countryHint: Two-letter code, like DE, FR or IN.
profile.company.identityHint: Invoices, contracts and customs papers are written against these. A change is checked by {{team}} before it replaces what is here now.
profile.company.displayNameHint: The name sellers and buyers see.
profile.company.taxHint: Whichever applies where you are registered.
profile.company.descriptionHint: What you carry and where. Characters left: {{remaining}}
profile.company.registeredHint: Where the company is legally registered.
profile.company.operationalHint: Where your vehicles actually leave from, if that is somewhere else.
profile.contacts.businessHint: The desk your partners reach first.
profile.contacts.emergencyHint: Who to call out of hours, when a delivery goes wrong.
profile.coverage.noRegions: No regions have been approved yet.
profile.coverage.hubsHint: Your own warehouses and depots. Up to 20.
profile.capabilities.evidenceHint: Worked out from your fleet, your drivers and the prices published for you. You cannot type these in.
profile.capabilities.fleetHint: To change these, update your fleet on the Drivers page.
profile.capabilities.declaredHint: What you say you run. It is shown as your own statement, not as an approval.
profile.compliance.uploadHint: PDF or an image, up to 10 MB. Files are checked for viruses, stored privately and reviewed by {{team}}.
profile.compliance.uploaded: Document uploaded. It will be reviewed.
profile.compliance.tooLarge: This file is larger than 10 MB.
profile.compliance.wrongType: Upload a PDF, or a JPEG, PNG, WebP or GIF image.
profile.compliance.notDownloadable: This file cannot be downloaded until it has passed the virus check.
profile.integration.title: Integration status
profile.integration.hint: What is connected to your account. Credentials and secrets are never shown here.
profile.integration.explain.CONNECTED: Working. A successful exchange has been recorded.
profile.integration.explain.ACTIVE: Positions have arrived in the last 24 hours.
profile.integration.explain.CONFIGURED_U: Set up by {{team}}, but no successful exchange has been recorded yet.
profile.integration.explain.CREDENTIALS_: Not connected. {{team}} needs an account with this carrier to connect it.
profile.integration.explain.ERROR: The last attempts failed. {{team}} has been told.
profile.integration.explain.MANUAL_TRACK: There is no connection to switch on. Tracking numbers are entered by hand.
profile.integration.explain.AWAITING_FIR: Ready, but no signed update has arrived yet.
profile.integration.explain.CONSENT_ONLY: Some drivers have agreed to share their location, but none has sent one in the last 24 hours.
profile.overview.integrationsDetail: DHL, FedEx, India Post, GPS and webhook
profile.review.pendingBody: Sent on {{when}}. Until it is approved, the current details stay in use.
profile.review.withdrawBody: Nothing will change. You can send a new request at any time.
profile.review.rejectedTitle: Your last change was not accepted
profile.review.noReason: No reason was given. Contact {{team}} operations.
profile.save.sentForReview: Sent for verification. The current details stay in use until it is approved.
profile.leave.title: Leave without saving?
profile.leave.body: Your changes on this page will be lost.
profile.account.name: Name
profile.account.securityDocs: Compliance documents are stored privately. Each download uses a link that works once, for you only, for a few minutes.
profile.account.securitySecrets: Carrier passwords, API keys and webhook secrets are never shown in this portal.
profile.account.securityReview: Changes to your legal name, tax number, registration or licence are checked by {{team}} before they take effect.
profile.account.historyEmpty: No changes have been recorded yet.
profile.account.historyNoAccess: Your role does not include the activity log.
